title: Hebian-To Advance Camp
subtitle: Guruk Colossus spawns for Brogosh's kill task

notes.title: Colossus count and respawn
notes.body: 9 Colossi are placed here, each from a 5-minute generator, so one pass gives 9 and you need about four passes for 30 kills.

notes.title: Best element
notes.body: Frost and piercing weapons do the most damage to Guruk Colossi (cold 70%, pierce 75%). Avoid acid (10%) and lightning (20%).

notes.title: Corrosive Cloud
notes.body: 139 Corrosive Cloud patches (40 pierce damage every 2 seconds) fill the corridors on the lower levels, so keep moving.

notes.title: Route coverage
notes.body: The route only reaches the Colossi nearest the entrance. The rest are spread over levels -30 to -54, with 67 level 5 Burun Eggs around.
